newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris sends sandbags to Germany, Poland.
newsitem.headline: Paris sends sandbags to Germany, Poland.

text.p: France on Monday sent 100,000 sandbags to bolster dikes on the swollen Oder River in Germany and Poland which have been plagued by month-long floods.
The Defence Ministry said that a German C-160 transport plane picked up the sandbags at an airbase near Orleans.

Germany has escaped the worst of a month of flooding from torrential rains in central Europe that killed more than 100 people in Poland and the Czech Republic, but damage to homes, businesses and farms has been extensive.
German officials breathed a sigh of relief after no new breaches were reported overnight in water-logged flood barriers holding back the Oder.

In Poland, where 162,500 people have been evacuated, 57 towns submerged by water, the Oder has begun receding at the town of Slubice on the German border, suggesting an end may be in sight to the crisis.
